hours.songTitle: If I Only Had A Brain (Extended Version)
stanza: I could while away the hours
Conferrin' with the flowers
Consultin' with the rain
And my head, I'd be scratchin'
While my thoughts were busy hatchin'
If I only had a brain

partner.line: I could while away the hours

hours.line: You can't clip my wings, can't wilt my flowers
stanza: You can't clip my wings, can't wilt my flowers
Stole my time, but I'll make up the hours
'Cause I'm a goddess and you know it
Some respect, you better show it
I'm done with you siphoning my power
Power

partner.line: Stole my time, but I'll make up the hours

hours.line: Picking me a bouquet of dogwood flowers
stanza: Heading down south to the land of the pines
I'm thumbing my way into North Caroline
Staring up the road and pray to God I see headlights
I made it down the coast in seventeen hours
Picking me a bouquet of dogwood flowers
And I'm a-hoping for Raleigh, I can see my baby tonight

partner.line: I made it down the coast in seventeen hours

stanza: Petals fell from flowers
Tell all of them were gone
In the long and dreadful hours
The wizard's curse played on
